name: singlet_harmonization_object_integrity_checks
title: Object integrity checks
description: Checks an annotated single-cell object for duplicate observation or feature names, dimension and row-alignment errors, orientation problems, stored-QC mismatches and declared-species conflicts, and lists the offending keys of each failing check. Use it on a newly built or imported object before count-state detection or schema conformance. It does not repair content: it renames duplicate names only when make_index_unique.policy is make_unique, and it records every renamed key in the report.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Layer read for shape, sparsity and QC recomputation; X is used when the layer is absent.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA for the row and column reductions when memory allows.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing anything.

overwrite.description: Replace existing uns/integrity and integrity flag members instead of failing.

declared_species.description: Species of the feature-symbol namespace, for example human or mouse. Falls back to uns/species; the species check abstains when neither is set.

strict.description: Treat anndata UserWarnings, such as duplicate names, as failures instead of warnings.

max_examples.description: Number of offending keys listed per failing check in the report.

make_index_unique.description: Options for duplicate observation and feature names.

policy.description: report lists duplicates; make_unique renames them and lists each renamed key; fail stops the check.

join.description: Delimiter between a duplicated name and its integer suffix.

content_checks.description: Options for the orientation, stored-QC and species checks.

orientation_mode.description: shape_only uses dimensions and sparsity; shape_then_content adds row and column statistics.

qc_rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance when recomputing stored per-cell totals from X.

symbol_margin_delta.description: Vocabulary-overlap margin below which the species check abstains.

mito_prefixes.description: Mitochondrial gene prefixes, matched case-insensitively by the species and QC checks.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) checked.

status.description: completed: checks ran and flags were written; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: checks (per check pass, fail, warn or abstain), n_flagged, renamed (count and first max_examples old and new names), species_call (declared, predicted, margin).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
